scope: Static ordinary owner API requests for the round 12 source review. No executable runner, primary data, cloud, or migration is part of this file.

required_sequence: Run both declarations and all seed writes on a fresh owned isolated node.
Wait for the seed writes to become durable. Stop the node normally, then reopen that same owned home.
Capture current native memory counters before metadata-cold-first-32.
Run metadata-cold-first-32 as one batch. Do not split it into serial requests.
Capture current native memory counters after the batch reply; all returned values and source filenames must match the seed.
Run metadata-next-extra-key after the prior batch completes, then capture current native memory counters.
expected_memory_behavior: The 32 reads fetch 1048576 payload-tip metadata filename bytes in total. This is a cumulative byte count, not a claim that all 32 paths remain in memory together. Shared atom identity does not make retained tip metadata free.

The batch may release child-query holds before its reply. Purge can then remove earlier clean paths during the batch. Only observed held paths justify memory above the configured cap; no request loses a value because of the cap.
Once the batch releases its holds, the extra key admission can purge additional clean old paths as needed. With no dirty or held records left, charged bytes stay within the configured cap.
Use current native counters, not the delayed general status sample. Record purged paths, charged bytes, metadata bytes, held records, and dirty records.
metadata_read_setup.wire_metadata_contract: Operation::Mutation accepts source_file_name. The normal field writer copies it into each field KeyMetadata. Arbitrary top-level metadata is not an accepted owner-operation field and is deliberately absent here.

requests.label: metadata-seed-all-33
requests.review: All 33 records share the same small payload. Each has a unique id and a 32768-character source filename. The normal field writer puts the accepted filename in each field tip metadata.

requests.label: metadata-cold-first-32
requests.review: After seed durability and a normal reopen, all 32 exact payload-only reads succeed. Compare each response source_file_name with that key source_file_name in metadata-seed-all-33. Each filename is 32768 characters. The shared payload atom does not make the 32 tip metadata allocations free.

requests.label: metadata-next-extra-key
requests.review: Run only after the prior batch completes. The new exact key admission can purge clean unheld records from the prior batch. Its value and 32768-character source filename remain correct.
